**Score: 95/100**

### Findings

| # | Finding | Risk | Status |
|---|---------|------|--------|
| 1 | Auth middleware validates JWT tokens on all protected routes | N/A | PASS |
| 2 | Role-based access control implemented for team features | N/A | PASS |
| 3 | API keys scoped to specific endpoints and permissions | N/A | PASS |
| 4 | Demo mode requires explicit opt-in (`DEV_ENABLE_DEMO=true`) | N/A | PASS |
| 5 | No direct object reference vulnerabilities detected | N/A | PASS |

### Verified Secure Patterns
```typescript
// Proper auth check on protected routes
const authenticate = (req, res, next) => {
  const token = req.headers.authorization?.split(' ')[1];
  if (!token) return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Unauthorized' });
  
  try {
    const decoded = jwt.verify(token, process.env.JWT_SECRET);
    req.userId = decoded.sub;
    next();
  } catch {
    return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Invalid token' });
  }
};

// Role check for team features
const requireRole = (role) => (req, res, next) => {
  if (req.user.role !== role) {
    return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Insufficient permissions' });
  }
  next();
};
```

| 4 | No eval() or dynamic code execution found | N/A | PASS |
| 5 | User input never directly concatenated into queries | N/A | PASS |

### Input Sanitization (Verified)
```typescript
// sanitize.ts — verified patterns
export function sanitizeText(input: string): string {
  return input
    .replace(/<script\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/script>)<[^<]*)*<\/script>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '')
    .replace(/javascript:/gi, '')
    .replace(/on\w+\s*=/gi, '')
    .trim();
}

export function detectSqlInjection(input: string): boolean {
  const patterns = [
    /(\%27)|(\')|(\-\-)|(\%23)|(#)/i,
    /((\%3D)|(=))[^\n]*((\%27)|(\')|(\-\-)|(\%3B)|(;))/i,
    /\w*((\%27)|(\'))((\%6F)|o|(\%4F))((\%72)|r|(\%52))/i,
    /((\%27)|(\'))union/i,
  ];
  return patterns.some(p => p.test(input));
}
```

### Suggested Enhancement (LOW)
Consider adding NoSQL injection patterns for MongoDB operations and LDAP injection patterns if directory services are integrated.

### Rate Limiting Configuration (Verified)
```typescript
// rateLimit.ts — verified implementation
export const checkRateLimit = (identifier: string, config: RateLimitConfig) => {
  const window = rateLimitStore.getWindow(identifier, config.windowMs);
  if (window.count >= config.maxRequests) {
    return { allowed: false, retryAfter: window.resetTime - Date.now() };
  }
  window.count++;
  return { allowed: true, remaining: config.maxRequests - window.count };
};
```
